meta.description: Turns paths into the surface around them with a fibrous relief along them. Every node that made paths is its own material group. Paths from set_color bring their color, the color goes over smoothly where paths of two colors meet.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Paths that grow into one body of tissue, like stipe and cap: the gaps between them fill. Paths from set_fill with a fill of 0 keep their gaps open, like gills or the veil

fibres.description: Relief along the paths. Paths from set_fibres bring their own.

blend.description: How far, in path radii, neighbouring paths join into one surface.

fill.description: Where a ball of this many path radii can't pass between body paths the gap fills, so single paths only show as fibres. 0 shows every path. Paths from set_fill bring their own.

loose_strands.description: Body paths that leave the surface: 0 = none, the tissue takes in every strand unless the strand is thicker than the deepest tissue, 1 = every one stays a strand. In between the tissue takes in a strand that stays closer to it than (1 / value - 1) times its half thickness there, so a thick stipe takes in longer strays than a thin cap margin.
